statement: The prevalence of maternal health problems varies among SUID cases based on postconceptional age.
rationale: This study uses a case-only analysis to explore how maternal health conditions differ across subgroups defined by postconceptional age within the ncfrp_v51 dataset. The design does not require incidence rates or population comparisons, focusing solely on associations among cases.
prior_art: The manuscript claims (e.g., C6, C7) and literature abstracts (e.g., suid_literature_abstracts.C10, C11) discuss maternal health risks such as smoking and obesity in relation to SUID. However, these studies do not specifically explore the variation of maternal health problems by postconceptional age.
cannot_establish: Incidence rates or risk ratios, causation.
